intro.text: A metal that grows as part of a dragon's body. On at least one dragon it forms the horns and claws, the spikes along the back and the ridges on the neck and limbs.
A metal that grows as part of a dragon's body, forming horns, claws and spikes. It looks silvery, almost liquid in the right light, and is immensely strong yet light enough to build with.

description.text: On at least one dragon, dragonsteel makes up the horns and claws, the spikes on the back and the ridges running along the neck and limbs.
It has a silvery look and can seem almost liquid in certain light. It is extremely strong and very light, and it can be used for building.
